name: reconstitution
wording: A session, new or compacted, recovers the design, its decisions, what is open and what is in flight from the concept journal and the ledger of the branch it is on, never from memory or a conversation: it reads the overview of each context its work touches first, the delivered workflow included, then the detail it needs, and records and changes nothing before it has given the operator its read-back.
reason: Nothing is recorded or changed at a session's start before the read-back; recording was not plainly a change, and the read-back's content now belongs to the read-back.
